answer:
Cristiano Ronaldo (full name Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, born February 5, 1985) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a forward. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]
Widely recognized as one of the greatest and most successful players in football history, he is known for his remarkable goal-scoring ability, physical strength, and longevity. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]

### Career Milestones
- **Club Career:** Began his professional career at Sporting CP in 2002 before moving on to Manchester United, Real Madrid (where he became the all-time leading goalscorer with 450 goals in 438 appearances), Juventus, and Saudi Arabian club Al Nassr. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]
His contract with Al Nassr runs through 2027 [SRC-83c65cc45d4b].
- **International Career:** Captains the Portugal national team, winning the UEFA European Championship in 2016 and the UEFA Nations League titles in 2019 and 2025. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]

### Major Achievements
- **Individual Awards:** Won five Ballon d'Or titles. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]
- **Club Honors:** Secured five UEFA Champions League titles alongside numerous domestic honors. [SRC-83c65cc45d4b]

### Cultural Impact
Beyond his athletic achievements, Ronaldo is a globally recognized sports personality, entrepreneur, brand ambassador, and philanthropist, making him one of the most influential athletes of the modern era [SRC-8105d04ebc58].

Biography
Cristiano Ronaldo dos Santos Aveiro, popularly known as Cristiano Ronaldo or CR7, is a Portuguese professional footballer widely regarded as one of the greatest players in the history of association football. Born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, he built an extraordinary career through his goal-scoring ability, speed, physical strength, aerial skills, discipline, and determination.
He has represented leading European clubs, including Manchester United, Real Madrid, and Juventus, before joining Saudi Arabian club Al-Nassr in 2023. He has also captained Portugal’s national team and helped the country win the 2016 UEFA European Championship and the 2019 and 2025 UEFA Nations League titles.
Ronaldo has won five Ballon d’Or awards, five UEFA Champions League titles, and numerous domestic and international honours. Beyond football, he is a globally recognised sports personality, entrepreneur, brand ambassador, and philanthropist. His remarkable longevity, commercial success, and record-breaking performances have made him one of the most influential athletes of the modern era.

Early Life and Childhood
Cristiano Ronaldo was born on February 5, 1985, in Funchal, the capital of Madeira, an Atlantic island region of Portugal. He grew up in a working-class family and developed an interest in football at an early age. His parents were Maria Dolores dos Santos Aveiro and José Dinis Aveiro.
His father worked in municipal gardening and also helped with equipment at a local football club, while his mother worked as a cook and later took on other jobs to support the household. Ronaldo was the youngest of four children, growing up alongside his older brother, Hugo, and sisters, Elma and Liliana Cátia.
The family’s financial circumstances were modest, and football became an important part of Ronaldo’s childhood. He spent much of his free time playing the game in neighbourhood streets and local pitches.
